screen.redstonelabworks.toolbox.subtitle: All build and analysis tools in one place.
config.redstonelabworks.hud.title: HUD Layer
config.redstonelabworks.hud.description: Controls Redstone Labworks popups and the radial wheel.
config.redstonelabworks.hud.tooltip: The configuration and toolbox screens remain available when disabled.
config.redstonelabworks.status_hud.title: Active Status HUD
config.redstonelabworks.status_hud.descr: Shows AutoWire mode, overlays, freeze state, and backend availability.
config.redstonelabworks.status_hud.toolt: A compact diagnostic panel visible during play.
config.redstonelabworks.status_anchor.de: Selects the corner used by the status panel.
config.redstonelabworks.status_anchor.to: Cycle through the four screen corners.
config.redstonelabworks.feedback.title: Feedback Output
config.redstonelabworks.feedback.descrip: Selects popup, chat, action bar, or a combined output.
config.redstonelabworks.feedback.tooltip: Applies to normal Redstone Labworks feedback messages.
config.redstonelabworks.teleport.title: Teleport Range
config.redstonelabworks.teleport.descrip: Maximum raycast distance from 10 to 1,000 blocks.
config.redstonelabworks.teleport.tooltip: Click to type an exact value or use the slider.
config.redstonelabworks.autowire.title: Active Wire Mode
config.redstonelabworks.autowire.descrip: Chooses the component placed above each new support block.
config.redstonelabworks.autowire.tooltip: The selected mode is synchronized with the server on join.
config.redstonelabworks.wire_preview.des: Previews the support block and AutoWire result before placement.
config.redstonelabworks.wire_preview.too: Can be frozen together with the analysis overlays.
config.redstonelabworks.bud.title: BUD Switch Overlay
config.redstonelabworks.bud.description: Highlights armed quasi-connectivity BUD states and their active power sources.
config.redstonelabworks.bud.tooltip: Red marks stale components; yellow marks the active quasi-power keeping them stale.
config.redstonelabworks.bud_range.title: BUD Search Radius
config.redstonelabworks.bud_range.descri: Spherical analysis radius from 4 to 64 blocks.
config.redstonelabworks.bud_range.toolti: Large values increase scanning work considerably.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk.title: Sculk Overlay
config.redstonelabworks.sculk.descriptio: Displays vibration ranges and wool occlusion.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk.tooltip: Normal and calibrated sensors are detected.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk_distance.d: Sensor discovery distance from 16 to 256 blocks.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk_distance.t: The global overlay distance can cap this value.
config.redstonelabworks.freeze.title: Overlay Snapshot
config.redstonelabworks.freeze.descripti: Freezes the latest wire, BUD, and sculk analysis.
config.redstonelabworks.freeze.tooltip: Move around while the captured geometry remains in place.
config.redstonelabworks.palette.title: Color Palette
config.redstonelabworks.palette.tooltip: Affects wire, BUD, and sculk overlay colors.
config.redstonelabworks.wire_color.title: Wire Preview Color
config.redstonelabworks.wire_color.descr: Custom RGB color for AutoWire preview geometry.
config.redstonelabworks.wire_color.toolt: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #33DD55.
config.redstonelabworks.risk_color.title: BUD Risk Color
config.redstonelabworks.risk_color.descr: Custom RGB color for armed quasi-connectivity components.
config.redstonelabworks.risk_color.toolt: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #FF3838.
config.redstonelabworks.source_color.des: Custom RGB color for active quasi-power sources.
config.redstonelabworks.source_color.too: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #FFD43B.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk_color.desc: Custom RGB color for sensor range geometry.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk_color.tool: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color such as #4EC9FF.
config.redstonelabworks.opacity.title: Overlay Opacity
config.redstonelabworks.opacity.tooltip: Click for exact input and a slider.
config.redstonelabworks.line_width.title: Overlay Line Width
config.redstonelabworks.line_width.descr: Sets outline width from 1 to 8 pixels.
config.redstonelabworks.line_width.toolt: Thicker lines improve visibility at high resolutions.
config.redstonelabworks.through_walls.de: Draws analysis geometry even when blocks obstruct it.
config.redstonelabworks.popup_anchor.des: Selects the corner used by popup notifications.
config.redstonelabworks.popup_anchor.too: Cycle through all four screen corners.
config.redstonelabworks.popup_duration.t: Click for exact input and a slider.
config.redstonelabworks.overlay_distance: Global analysis cap from 8 to 256 blocks.
Limits expensive BUD and sculk searches.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk_interval.d: Geometry rebuild interval from 1 to 100 ticks.
config.redstonelabworks.sculk_interval.t: Higher values reduce work for mostly static builds.
screen.redstonelabworks.sculk_info.subti: Vibration events grouped by calibrated sensor frequency
